wolfSSL
Copyright wolfSSL Inc. and contributors.
Distributed under GPL version 3; see upstream COPYING.
The official build downloads the latest stable upstream release selected by
UPSTREAM.json. The source archive is not included in this repository.
Downloaded source, build cache and release/hash records stay under
source/tcard/out/deps/ and are not distributed as repository source.
The dependency build supplies COPYING for the artifact license step.
Build settings: source/tcard/build/sync-dependencies.ps1.
Upstream releases: https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/releases/latest
TLS 1.3 PSK documentation: https://www.wolfssl.com/documentation/manuals/wolfssl/group__Setup.html
